// Costume Roulette enhancement services.
// The item and stone registries are generated by tools/generate_costume_enhancement.py.

function	script	F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck	{
	.@item_id = getarg(0);
	return inarray(getvariableofnpc(.Ids[0], "costume_roulette_db"), .@item_id) != -1;
}

function	script	F_CostumeEnhanceSelectStone	{
	.@group = getarg(0);
	.@mask = getarg(1);
	.@start = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.RangeStart[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@group);
	.@size = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.RangeCount[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@group);
	.@letter_menu$ = "";
	.@letter_value[0] = -1;
	.@letter_count = 0;
	for (.@i = .@start; .@i < .@start + .@size; ++.@i) {
		if (getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.Mask[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@i) & .@mask) {
			.@letter = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.Letter[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@i);
			.@letter_present[.@letter] = 1;
		}
	}
	if (.@letter_present[26]) {
		.@letter_value[.@letter_count] = 26;
		.@letter_menu$ += "0-9:";
		++.@letter_count;
	}
	for (.@letter = 0; .@letter < 26; ++.@letter) {
		if (.@letter_present[.@letter]) {
			.@letter_value[.@letter_count] = .@letter;
			.@letter_menu$ += charat("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", .@letter) + ":";
			++.@letter_count;
		}
	}
	if (.@letter_count < 1)
		return -1;
	mes "Choose a letter section.";
	.@letter_choice = select(.@letter_menu$ + "Cancel") - 1;
	if (.@letter_choice == .@letter_count)
		return -1;
	.@selected_letter = .@letter_value[.@letter_choice];
	.@count = 0;
	for (.@i = .@start; .@i < .@start + .@size; ++.@i) {
		if ((getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.Mask[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@i) & .@mask) && getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.Letter[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@i) == .@selected_letter) {
			.@index[.@count] = .@i;
			++.@count;
		}
	}
	if (.@count < 1)
		return -1;
	.@page_count = (.@count + 19) / 20;
	for (.@page = 0; .@page < .@page_count; ++.@page) {
		.@page_start = .@page * 20;
		.@menu$ = "";
		.@shown = 0;
		for (.@j = .@page_start; .@j < .@count && .@shown < 20; ++.@j) {
			.@row = .@index[.@j];
			.@stone = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.StoneId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@row);
			.@menu$ += getitemname(.@stone) + " (" + countitem(.@stone) + ") :";
			++.@shown;
		}
		if (.@page_start + .@shown < .@count)
			.@menu$ += "Next page:Cancel";
		else
			.@menu$ += "Cancel";
		.@choice = select(.@menu$) - 1;
		if (.@choice < 0 || .@choice > .@shown)
			return -1;
		if (.@choice == .@shown) {
			if (.@page + 1 < .@page_count)
				continue;
			return -1;
		}
		return .@index[.@page_start + .@choice];
	}
	return -1;
}

function	script	F_CostumeEnhanceHead	{
	if (!checkweight(1119, 3)) {
		mes "Make some room in your inventory before we begin.";
		return;
	}
	.@part = -1;
	.@equip_id = -1;
	if (getequipid(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP) > -1) {
		.@part = EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP;
		.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	}
	else if (getequipid(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_MID) > -1) {
		.@part = EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_MID;
		.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	}
	else if (getequipid(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW) > -1) {
		.@part = EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW;
		.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	}
	if (.@equip_id < 0 || !callfunc("F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck", .@equip_id)) {
		mes "You must wear a Costume Headgear from the Costume Roulette pool.";
		return;
	}
	.@location = getiteminfo(.@equip_id, ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS);
	.@slot_menu$ = "";
	.@slot_value[0] = -1;
	.@slot_count = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < 3; ++.@i) {
		.@location_bit = (.@i == 0 ? EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP : .@i == 1 ? EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_MID : EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW);
		.@registry_bit = 1 << .@i;
		if (.@location & .@location_bit) {
			.@slot_value[.@slot_count] = .@i;
			.@slot_menu$ += (.@i == 0 ? "Upper:" : .@i == 1 ? "Middle:" : "Lower:");
			++.@slot_count;
		}
	}
	if (.@slot_count < 1) {
		mes "This costume has no supported head enhancement slot.";
		return;
	}
	.@slot_menu$ += "Cancel:";
	.@choice = select(.@slot_menu$) - 1;
	if (.@choice == .@slot_count)
		return;
	.@slot = .@slot_value[.@choice];
	.@stone_index = callfunc("F_CostumeEnhanceSelectStone", .@slot, 1 << .@slot);
	if (.@stone_index < 0)
		return;
	.@stone = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.StoneId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@stone_index);
	.@enchant = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.EnchantId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@stone_index);
	.@refine = getequiprefinerycnt(.@part);
	setarray .@card[0], getequipcardid(.@part, 0), getequipcardid(.@part, 1), getequipcardid(.@part, 2), getequipcardid(.@part, 3);
	if (countitem(.@stone) < 1) {
		mes "You no longer have that stone.";
		return;
	}
	mes "Apply ^0000FF" + getitemname(.@stone) + "^000000 to ^0000FF" + getitemname(.@equip_id) + "^000000?";
	mes "Failure consumes the stone and clears only this enchant slot.";
	if (select("Apply:Cancel") == 2)
		return;
	if (getequipid(.@part) != .@equip_id || countitem(.@stone) < 1 || !callfunc("F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck", getequipid(.@part)) || callfunc("F_IsEquipIDHack", .@part, .@equip_id) || callfunc("F_IsEquipCardHack", .@part, .@card[0], .@card[1], .@card[2], .@card[3]) || callfunc("F_IsEquipRefineHack", .@part, .@refine)) {
		mes "The equipment changed while I was preparing the enhancement.";
		return;
	}
	delitem .@stone, 1;
	delequip .@part;
	if (rand(100) < 75) {
		.@card[.@slot] = .@enchant;
		mes "Success! The costume looks wonderful.";
	}
	else {
		.@card[.@slot] = 0;
		mes "The enhancement failed. The stone was consumed, but your other enchant slots are safe.";
	}
	getitem2 .@equip_id, 1, 1, .@refine, 0, .@card[0], .@card[1], .@card[2], .@card[3];
return;
}

function	script	F_CostumeEnhanceGarment	{
	if (!checkweight(1119, 3)) {
		mes "Make some room in your inventory before we begin.";
		return;
	}
	.@part = EQI_COSTUME_GARMENT;
	.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	if (.@equip_id < 0 || !callfunc("F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck", .@equip_id) || !(getiteminfo(.@equip_id, ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS) & EQP_COSTUME_GARMENT)) {
		mes "You must wear a Costume Garment from the Costume Roulette pool.";
		return;
	}
	.@kind = select("Garment Stone:Dual Stone:Cancel");
	if (.@kind == 3)
		return;
	.@slot = .@kind - 1;
	.@stone_index = callfunc("F_CostumeEnhanceSelectStone", 3 + .@slot, 8);
	if (.@stone_index < 0)
		return;
	.@stone = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.StoneId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@stone_index);
	.@enchant = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.EnchantId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@stone_index);
	.@refine = getequiprefinerycnt(.@part);
	setarray .@card[0], getequipcardid(.@part, 0), getequipcardid(.@part, 1), getequipcardid(.@part, 2), getequipcardid(.@part, 3);
	mes "Apply ^0000FF" + getitemname(.@stone) + "^000000 to ^0000FF" + getitemname(.@equip_id) + "^000000?";
	mes "Failure consumes the stone and clears only this enchant slot.";
	if (select("Apply:Cancel") == 2)
		return;
	if (getequipid(.@part) != .@equip_id || countitem(.@stone) < 1 || !callfunc("F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck", getequipid(.@part)) || callfunc("F_IsEquipIDHack", .@part, .@equip_id) || callfunc("F_IsEquipCardHack", .@part, .@card[0], .@card[1], .@card[2], .@card[3]) || callfunc("F_IsEquipRefineHack", .@part, .@refine)) {
		mes "The equipment changed while I was preparing the enhancement.";
		return;
	}
	delitem .@stone, 1;
	delequip .@part;
	if (rand(100) < 75) {
		.@card[.@slot] = .@enchant;
		mes "Success! Your garment is ready.";
	}
	else {
		.@card[.@slot] = 0;
		mes "The enhancement failed. Your other enchant slot is safe.";
	}
	getitem2 .@equip_id, 1, 1, .@refine, 0, .@card[0], .@card[1], .@card[2], .@card[3];
return;
}

function	script	F_CostumeEnhanceEffect	{
	if (!checkweight(1119, 3)) {
		mes "Make some room in your inventory before we begin.";
		return;
	}
	.@part = -1;
	.@equip_id = -1;
	if (getequipid(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP) > -1) {
		.@part = EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP;
		.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	}
	else if (getequipid(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_MID) > -1) {
		.@part = EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_MID;
		.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	}
	else if (getequipid(EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW) > -1) {
		.@part = EQI_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW;
		.@equip_id = getequipid(.@part);
	}
	if (.@equip_id < 0 || !callfunc("F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck", .@equip_id)) {
		mes "You must wear a Costume Headgear from the Costume Roulette pool.";
		return;
	}
	.@location = getiteminfo(.@equip_id, ITEMINFO_LOCATIONS);
	.@registry_mask = 0;
	if (.@location & EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_TOP) .@registry_mask |= 1;
	if (.@location & EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_MID) .@registry_mask |= 2;
	if (.@location & EQP_COSTUME_HEAD_LOW) .@registry_mask |= 4;
	.@stone_index = callfunc("F_CostumeEnhanceSelectStone", 5, .@registry_mask);
	if (.@stone_index < 0)
		return;
	.@stone = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.StoneId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@stone_index);
	.@enchant = getelementofarray(getvariableofnpc(.EnchantId[0], "costume_enhancement_db"), .@stone_index);
	.@refine = getequiprefinerycnt(.@part);
	setarray .@card[0], getequipcardid(.@part, 0), getequipcardid(.@part, 1), getequipcardid(.@part, 2), getequipcardid(.@part, 3);
	mes "Apply ^0000FF" + getitemname(.@stone) + "^000000 to ^0000FF" + getitemname(.@equip_id) + "^000000?";
	mes "Failure consumes the stone and clears only the visual effect slot.";
	if (select("Apply:Cancel") == 2)
		return;
	if (getequipid(.@part) != .@equip_id || countitem(.@stone) < 1 || !callfunc("F_CostumeEnhancePoolCheck", getequipid(.@part)) || callfunc("F_IsEquipIDHack", .@part, .@equip_id) || callfunc("F_IsEquipCardHack", .@part, .@card[0], .@card[1], .@card[2], .@card[3]) || callfunc("F_IsEquipRefineHack", .@part, .@refine)) {
		mes "The equipment changed while I was preparing the enhancement.";
		return;
	}
	delitem .@stone, 1;
	delequip .@part;
	if (rand(100) < 75) {
		.@card[3] = .@enchant;
		mes "Success! The effect is dazzling.";
	}
	else {
		.@card[3] = 0;
		mes "The effect enhancement failed. Your stat enchants are safe.";
	}
	getitem2 .@equip_id, 1, 1, .@refine, 0, .@card[0], .@card[1], .@card[2], .@card[3];
return;
}

mal_in01,24,121,2	script	Gregio Grumani#cos_ect	4_CAT_SAILOR5,{
	disable_items;
	mes "[Gregio Grumani]";
	mes "I apply Costume Effect Stones to the fourth enchant slot.";
	mes "The success chance is 75%.";
	if (select("Continue:Cancel") != 1)
		close;
	callfunc("F_CostumeEnhanceEffect");
	close;
}
